review.official:
Former
Ursus
underground fighter, Beehunter joined
Rhodes Island
after the scene broke up.
Now a
guard
who loves to show off her destructive prowess.

files.description:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in her circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming her as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 1%
Surveillance is recommended for rare cases like this. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.14u/L 
Minor infection currently showing no sign of spreading.

A freeform fighter.
She's the simple, easily fulfilled eat-sleep-repeat type. 
She enjoys dried fish and honey. So much so, that if offered a compensation package with only those two items, she would actually mull it over.

Since her underground fighting circuit broke up and everyone involved went into hiding, Rhodes Island has had a hard time gathering records of her past. 
Beehunter doesn't remember her own childhood well. All she knows for certain is she's been making a living off underground fights since a very young age. 
Her ideals come from the underground fighting lifestyle: Live simply, be rude when you have to, solve problems with your fists, and live in the moment.

There are no rules in underground fights. Winning is all that matters. 
When fighting one-on-one, Beehunter can beat most opponents on talent alone. 
However, on the battlefield, we rarely have the luxury of a one-on-one fight. Certainly not one with no interference. In short, Beehunter's skillset is not well suited to Rhodes Island's work.

But Rhodes Island doesn't turn down such talent due to combat capabilities alone. Beehunter's... simplicity left her drill instructor baffled during her onboarding. 
In the end, we decided to focus on her strengths: Take her opponents one at a time and knock them down as fast as possible. 
She quite likes this tactic because she doesn't need to think. Still, she does need to learn to observe the flow of battle.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Boss, let's go grab a bite. On you this time. What? You bought last time? Doesn't sound right to me.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Use my head to win fights? Hmm… Hmm… Pummel them until I win, train harder if I lose. That's using your head!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Honey's sweet, but getting it hurts. I went for some the other day… They really give me a hard lesson.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: My knuckles? Haha~ They're my precious babies. Wouldn't have racked up all those wins without 'em!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: There's more rules in the underground fight scene than you might think. Plenty of gopniks dove in before they had 'em figured out. They usually ended up dead.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Oripathy? Who cares? Infected, Uninfected... They're all the same after I knock their lights out.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: What? The fin in the kitchen? Hah! Right here in my belly now!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: My book of names here? Ah, looks like that big brain of yours doesn't know everything. Gotta meet people to fight people, right? I don't want to run out of enemies.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: The only reason I joined the underground fight is 'cause I didn't have two kopecks to rub together. But here on Rhodes Island I got that load off my mind. It's all thanks to you, Boss!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Smells like grilled fish!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Yo! Boss, you know a winner when you see her! Now, put your hands together for the strongest underground fighter out there. The one! The only! BEEEEEEEE-HUNTERRRRRR!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I really don't wanna study. Send me out to fight already!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Hah hah hah! Somebody likes me a lot!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Hah! After this promotion, ain't no way I'm gonna let you down! Lemme show you what I can do in a fight, Boss!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Here I come!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Chow's on me after we win this one!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Relax, Boss. Ain't nobody can go three rounds with me!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: So you're the ones looking for a beatdown. You guys?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: What's up?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ready?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Gimme the bell!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Let's do this.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Eat this!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Get over here!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: One-two, one-two, one-two!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: C'mon, c'mon! Bring it on!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: The stronger the matchup, the more pumped I get!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: K.O.! Check it out, Boss. See 'em all piled up there?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: That's a wrap. Let's head back and chow down!

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ouch… Where's the Boss? Is the Boss okay?!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: This room's a lot better than any I had before!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You brought food? You're the best, Boss!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Hey, hey, hey! There you are, boss! I was just out having some honey with the others! Man, it's nice to have a stable income. Now I can buy as much honey as I want. Sure beats gathering it myself, with all the stinging... You're the best, boss!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: What's up, Boss.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Honey-grilled fins! I just came up with the recipe a few days ago, and it's sure to be a blast! Same goes for fin jerky with honey. Why aren't I sharing any then? I couldn't hold myself back and ate it all last night.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: The way Rhodes Island fights is different from what I'm used to, but that doesn't bother me one bit! And I only learned after coming here how many people look down on the Infected. But don't worry! Me and my fist will change their minds!
